title: Eli Lilly bets on AI drugs in $2.75B deal: What to know
title_zh: 礼来 (Eli Lilly) 在 $2.75B 交易中押注人工智能药物：要知道什么
summary: Eli Lilly (LLY) is bringing artificial intelligence (AI) drugs to the global market in a $2.75 billion deal with Insilico.Defiance ETFs CEO and CIO Sylvia Jablonski and Yahoo Finance Tech Editor discuss.
summary_zh: 礼来公司 (LLY) 将与 Insilico 达成 27.5 亿美元的交易，将人工智能 (AI) 药物推向全球市场。Defiance ETF 首席执行官兼首席信息官 Sylvia Jablonski 与雅虎财经技术编辑进行讨论。

title: Oil Climbs as Trump Threatens War Escalation If No Deal Soon
title_zh: 特朗普威胁如果不尽快达成协议，战争升级，油价上涨
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Oil prices rose after President Donald Trump threatened attacks on Iran’s energy infrastructure, overshadowing his comments that a deal to end hostilities in the Middle East could be close.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——唐纳德·特朗普总统威胁袭击伊朗能源基础设施后，油价上涨，盖过了他有关结束中东敌对行动可能达成的协议的言论。

title: JPMorgan Faces Pushback on $7.2 Billion Sealed Air Debt Deal

summary: Investors question terms and protections as demand builds unevenly across bonds and loans tied to CD&R's Sealed Air acquisition.
summary_zh: 由于与 CD&R 收购 Sealed Air 相关的债券和贷款的需求不均衡，投资者对条款和保护提出质疑。
